definitions.explanation: The reduction or complete waiving of taxes, fees, penalties, or other financial obligations.

examples.japanese: {税金|ぜいきん}の{減免|げんめん}を{申請|しんせい}する。
examples.english: To apply for a tax reduction.

examples.japanese: {授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}の{減免|げんめん}{制度|せいど}があります。
examples.english: There is a tuition reduction/exemption system.

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}で{被害|ひがい}を{受|う}けた{人|ひと}は{保険料|ほけんりょう}の{減免|げんめん}を{受|う}けられる。
examples.english: People affected by a disaster can receive a reduction in insurance premiums.

notes:
A compound of {減|げん} (reduction) and {免|めん} (exemption) used in administrative and legal contexts. This word covers the full spectrum from partial reduction to complete waiver of financial obligations. Commonly encountered in tax forms, university tuition policies, and government aid programs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {税金|ぜいきん}の{減免|げんめん}: tax relief
- {授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}{減免|げんめん}: tuition reduction/exemption
- {減免|げんめん}{措置|そち}: relief measures
- {減免|げんめん}{制度|せいど}: reduction/exemption system
- {減免|げんめん}を{受|う}ける: to receive a reduction/exemption

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {免除|めんじょ}: exemption — full waiver only, no partial reduction
- {軽減|けいげん}: reduction/alleviation — focuses on lessening a burden, broader than financial contexts
